title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: The text refers to 'l'hom (53) est un mono'; it should be (54). (53) is the definition of the modular case.

Minor: the semidirect-product description in (56) does not spell out how the copies of -1 in Z/6, in D_4 and in SL(2,Z) sit relative to each other. As stated it is an abstract decomposition of M(Z), not a statement about intersections inside GL_2. No genuine error is apparent.

The injectivity claim 'for 2 invertible' is plausible but not argued. It needs the orders of ρ and σ in the respective special tori to remain 6 and 4 fibrewise. In characteristic 3, ρ = -1 + nilpotent still has order 6, so this holds.

ideas.what: Embedding of the cyclic groups generated by the elliptic elements ρ (order 6) and σ (order 4) of SL_2(Z) into the centre of the identity component of the symmetry group scheme M°_{ρ,σ}, injective when 2 is invertible
ideas.modern_name: centre computation for the automorphism group scheme of the modular presentation Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6 ≅ SL_2(Z)
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (structure of SL_2(Z) as an amalgam; Serre, Trees)

ideas.what: M_{ρ,σ}(Z) ≅ (Z/6 × D_4) ⋉ SL(2,Z), with the action through ε_2 and τ_∞ = diag(-1,1)
ideas.modern_name: units of Z[ζ_6], normaliser of Z[i]^* in GL_2(Z), and the outer automorphism of SL_2(Z) (PGL_2(Z) ≅ Aut PSL_2(Z))

deep.surprise_reason: A routine specialisation of a group-scheme computation to the modular case. It produces standard facts: the units of Z[ζ_6], D_4 as the normaliser of Z[i]^*, and the diag(-1,1) outer automorphism of SL_2(Z). Nothing appears new beyond the private framework of M_{ρ,σ}.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 should read roughly 'ou que σ (en tant qu') élément de T_σ est dans ST_σ', not 'on que σ [-...-] qui élément de T_σ'.
'dont l'image, pour 2 inversible sur S, contient' is followed by a repeated word 'contient' in the manuscript (a slip of the pen).
'via la conation[?]' is probably 'via le caractère' (ε_2 : D_4 → Z/2Z ≃ {1, τ_∞}).
Above the semidirect-product note, 𝒟_{ρ,σ} is likely 𝒯_{ρ,σ}(Z) (or its D-variant) ≅ Z/6Z × D_4.
Struck line before (55) begins 'i_B ...' (cancelled; possibly i_{B} : ... → M_{ρ,σ}[0]).
'l'hom (53) est un mono' in the manuscript should be understood as (54).
